newsitem.title: USA: Tiffany to open Seattle location in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Tiffany to open Seattle location in 1998.

text.p: Tiffany & Co said on Monday it will open a store in Seattle in fall of 1998 as part of its plan to open three new U.S. stores annually.
Tiffany will open the Seattle store at Pacific Place, it said in a statement.
Tiffany also said it plans to relocate its San Diego store in January 1998 to the Fashion Valley Shopping Center.
"Seattle is a highly desirable, dynamic market that is ideally suited for the opening of this 7,000 square foot store," James Quinn, executive vice president, said in a statement.

The Seattle location is in addition to the previously announced store openings scheduled for fall 1998 at the Bellagio in Las Vegas, Nevada and at the Cherry Creek shopping center in Denver, Colorado.
The existing Tiffany store in the Paladion in San Diego, which opened in 1992, will remain open through the 1997 holiday season, the company said.
Tiffany presently operates over 100 jewelry and luxury goods stores worldwide, including 24 U.S. locations.
